conviction_note: Real Q3 report, no pre-release and no guidance. The release is due after the close on Fri 2026-11-27, so the reaction falls on Mon 2026-11-30. The PAP consensus bar could not be reached and every finding is a proxy: a weaker zloty helps (revenue translation plus FX revaluation of cash), Q3 launches were modest, and the y/y base is low. The findings net to +0.1 and the scaled number is +0.18 (abs 4.5 x p_up 52). The two agree that there is no real edge.

Financial income: FX revaluation gains likely, because USD/PLN went from about 3.74 at end-June to about 3.94 at end-September. Up, but below EBIT.
None. PlayWay publishes no numeric guidance, so at most commentary on the Q4 launch slate and CMS 2027 timing. No change expected.

findings.finding: The zloty weakened through Q3 2026: USD/PLN month-ends were about 3.74 (Jun), 3.74 (Jul), 3.85 (Aug) and 3.94 (Sep), against about 3.64-3.66 in Q3 2025. That gives a few percent of translation tailwind on USD Steam revenue y/y and q/q, plus FX revaluation gains on USD cash and receivables, which land in financial income below EBIT. The company named FX volatility as a key factor for the next quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed record of PLW reacting to an FX-driven line. H1 2026 (net profit up y/y) drew about +2% on the next session (Parkiet, 2026-09-28).
findings.why_not_priced: USD/PLN is public, so a covering analyst will have the revenue translation in the consensus. What may not be in it is the size of the revaluation gain on the cash pile (current assets 372m PLN at H1). That depends on the USD share of the cash, which is not disclosed in anything I could reach. With one analyst and $146k/day of turnover, nobody is visibly positioned for it; the stock went 250 -> 243 over the month while USD/PLN rose.
findings.independence: The company's own outlook flags FX (Quartr Q2 2026 summary: 'Key factors for the next quarter include FX volatility, new game launches', https://quartr.com/events/playway-sa-plw-q2-2026_FLlqcpQq). Polish FX press: USD/PLN approaching 4 zł in November (https://comparic.pl/dolar-zmierza-w-strone-4-zl-co-z-kursem-zlotego-w-piatek-13-11-2026-r/).

findings.finding: Q3 2026 had no breakout launch. Ore Factory Squat (July) made $444k Steam net in 72h and the CEO called it only 'poprawna'. Low-Budget Repairs (13 Aug, ~1m wishlists before launch) is estimated at 55-110k copies (2,754 reviews), about $1.1-2.2m gross. The September releases (Sunken Engine and others) sit at 0-20k owners on SteamSpy. Against Q2's 88.2m revenue, which one title drove, Q3 revenue likely slips q/q.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (revenue 75.2m, EBIT -46% y/y) was followed by a DM BOŚ Kupuj on 2025-12-01 at 259 PLN. No clear sell-off is on record.
findings.original_quote: „Premiera 'Ore Factory Squat' była poprawna” ... W 72 godziny wolumen gry wyniósł 60,5 tys. ... Przychody Steam netto ... wyniosły 444 tys. USD (The 'Ore Factory Squat' launch was adequate ... 60.5k units in 72 hours ... Steam net revenue $444k)
findings.why_not_priced: Launch data is public on Steam and in the press, so it is mostly priced. What is left is how much of Q2's one-title uplift repeats. StockWatch's H1 note says one title drove most of the growth and costs are rising faster than sales. If the market had priced a q/q fall, the stock would not have held 240-250 since the H1 report.
findings.independence: Steam Page Analyzer estimate for Low-Budget Repairs, read 2026-11-25 (https://www.steampageanalyzer.com/games/3167920). StockWatch H1 analysis: 'Jeden tytuł odpowiada za większość przyrostu przychodów' (https://www.stockwatch.pl/wiadomosci/analiza-playway-wyniki-na-nowych-zasadach-rachunkowosci,akcje,382701, 2026-10-12).

findings.finding: The y/y comparison base is unusually weak. Q3 2025 had revenue 75.2m, EBIT 25.6m (-46% y/y) and net to parent 11.8m (-74% y/y), so the Q3 2026 headline growth rates in PAP/ESPI wire copy will very likely be large and positive even on a flat-to-down q/q quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2026, 'zyski rosną' headlines: about +2% intraday on 2026-09-28 (https://www.parkiet.com/technologie/art45202481-playway-nie-zwalnia-tempa-zyski-rosna). findings.original_quote: 2025/Q3 (wrz 25): Przychody ze sprzedaży 75 238; Zysk operacyjny 25 591 r/r -45.98%; Zysk netto akcjonariuszy jednostki dominującej 11 807 r/r -74.17% (Q3 2025: revenue 75,238k PLN; operating profit 25,591k, -45.98% y/y; net profit to parent 11,807k, -74.17% y/y)
findings.why_not_priced: A consensus already includes the base, so this is a claim about how the release is presented on a retail-heavy, thinly traded name, not about the number. Note that the 2025 comparatives were restated under the new IAS 38 treatment (H1 2025 EBIT 85.3m restated vs 91.3m originally), so the reported y/y may differ from the table.

lessons_applied: 'A beat made of a one-off is sold': most of the FX upside is revaluation in financial income, below EBIT, so the FX finding goes from +0.5 to +0.3
Unsourced bar and 'a verified fact is not a predicted reaction': the low-base headline finding goes from +0.3 to +0.2, p_up from 53 to 52, and print_vs_bar from +3 to +2

'Too small about the move' (18 of 23 under-sized): abs_move goes from 4.0 to 4.5, because the numbers are new with no pre-release, coverage is thin and the name's history scale is a biased-low cadence estimate
Session lesson: session_check now opens with 'amc' and cites timestamped URLs, so the resolver uses the 11-27 close -> 11-30 close window
